reviews.t: The best longest lasting Mascara in the world! No more Raccoon eyes.

I previously ordered the black tube and loved it. This came dried out and the top broke off the lash brush the first time I used it. It barely looked like I was wearing mascara. I returned and ordered the black.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise it for not smudging or causing raccoon eyes.
Several reviewers complain it clumps, flakes, or leaves bits on the face.
Some reviewers say it takes too long to apply or dry.
Some reviewers find it lacks length, volume, or coverage.
A few reviewers feel it is not worth the price or disappointed overall.
